name: Situation Materiel Prete
query: SELECT p.date_pret AS `Date:Date:100`, p.name AS `Prêt:Link/Pret Materiel:180`, p.fournisseur AS `Fournisseur:Link/Supplier:180`, l.materiel AS `Matériel:Link/Materiel Huilerie:160`, l.quantite_pretee AS `Prêtée:Float:90`, l.quantite_rendue AS `Rendue:Float:90`, l.quantite_restante AS `Restante:Float:90`, l.montant_caution AS `Valeur:Currency:120`, p.statut AS `Statut:Data:120` FROM `tabPret Materiel` p JOIN `tabLigne Pret Materiel` l ON l.parent=p.name WHERE p.docstatus=1 ORDER BY p.date_pret DESC
